name: vivo Y31 5G (Demo Unit)
shortDescription: Open-box demo unit of the vivo Y31 5G with a 16.96 cm (6.68 inch) 120 Hz display, 6500 mAh battery with 44 W charging, IP68 and IP69, 4 GB RAM and 128 GB storage.
description:
This is a demo (display) unit of the vivo Y31 5G that was used for in-store demonstration. It may show light signs of handling. Please contact us before ordering if you'd like to know its exact condition, accessories included and remaining manufacturer warranty.

The vivo Y31 5G has a 16.96 cm (6.68 inch) HD+ LCD display with up to 120 Hz refresh rate and runs on the Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 processor with 4 GB RAM and 128 GB storage, expandable up to 2 TB. It has a 6500 mAh battery (typical) with 44 W charging, a 50 MP rear camera and an 8 MP front camera, and is rated IP68 and IP69. It runs Funtouch OS 15 based on Android 15.
